lina (devex): heads up — running into a weird failure in the Node sampleapp when we do embeddings + rerank in the same flow. intermittent crash when reshaping vectors.
omar (sdk): ugh, can you paste the exact error?
marta (eng-ml): seen something like this before when helper pads vectors differently between embed and rerank calls.
harry (sampleapp): here are the logs I have from the failing run:
```
Error: InvalidArgument: expected embeddings[0].length == 1536, got 1537
 at parseVectors (/usr/src/app/src/vec.ts:48:15)
 at processBatch (/usr/src/app/src/batcher.ts:102:9)
Caused by: Unexpected key null in rerank request body
```
lina (devex): same. it looks like our batching helper sometimes appends a sentinel 0 to the float array when a retry fires — only on hot-paths where auth refresh + retry happen together.
omar (sdk): wait, how often does the retry happen? token refresh race?
harry (sampleapp): about 1 in 200 requests on staging. 401 triggers token-refresh and we re-enqueue the batch, then the batcher dedup path does a shallow concat that added an extra 0 element.
marta (eng-ml): that explains the off-by-one dim. also saw the rerank envelope code fallback to `{ items: null }` when the scoring step errors, hence the "Unexpected key null" log. two separate failure modes colliding.
omar (sdk): thanks — two fixes: 1) make the batcher concat defensive (deep copy / assert dims before sending), 2) make the client schema validation stricter and return a clear 400 instead of sending malformed body.
lina (devex): I can put up a minimal patch to the sampleapp to assert shapes before calling the SDK. patch gist: `if (vec.length !== modelDims) throw new Error("vec dim mismatch")`
harry (sampleapp): quick mitigation works. any plan for SDK-side release?
omar (sdk): creating a tiny patch to v0.9.2 -> v0.9.3 that: fixes concat bug, adds a verifyVectors() check, and makes retry path idempotent w.r.t. batch arrays. will also add a unit test that simulates concurrent token refresh + batch retry.
replay-bot: deploy queued: sdk/v0.9.3 -> canary (1 host)
marta (eng-ml): can we also add a short integration test in ci that runs the sampleapp flow and validates envelope shape for rerank responses? Catches the `items: null` fallback.
omar (sdk): yes, adding a small e2e that mocks a 401 during embed and ensures the final rerank request is well-formed.
lina (devex): sweet. leaving a note here: onboarding guide should mention to enable strict shape-checking in dev mode (`REDWOOD_VEC_STRICT=1`) — prevents these silent padding issues during early testing.
harry (sampleapp): will add line to README + a quick migration note for teams using the helper.
omar (sdk): thanks all. I'll post the PR link when ready. if anyone sees more flaky 401+retry combos, tag me @omar. :thumbsup:
lina (devex): thanks — saved a customer from a confusing 500 with no clear cause. keeping this thread for postmortem notes.
